mainEntity.name: Do I need to change my entire website for AI Overviews optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is unlikely that you will need to change your entire website. Optimization typically involves strategic content enhancements, structural adjustments, and technical improvements. We focus on refining existing high-value content, identifying gaps for new content creation, and ensuring your site's technical foundation supports AI crawling and indexing. The goal is to leverage your current assets while making targeted improvements that maximize your chances of appearing in AI Overviews without a complete overhaul.
acceptedAnswer.description: A complete website overhaul is usually not necessary. Optimization focuses on strategic content enhancements, structural adjustments, and technical improvements to existing assets.
